profile.name: Ali Guzelyel
profile.tagline: Studying social networks on affects of online interactions
profile.description: ali guzelyel, ml, phd in cs

bullets: Conducting causal inference and counterfactual analysis on large scale social media user behavior data.
Leveraging LLMs to extract user stance and linguistic signals for downstream causal modeling and simulations. (NSF-funded, in collaboration with Tulane University)

Owned the end-to-end integration process with third-party flight information management systems such as Cargo AI and IBS, leading technical discussions internally and with partners to enable access to flight and cargo data from 100+ airlines globally.
Optimized the process using in-context learning with GPT-4o for better timelines, getting faster with each integration.
Developed full stack with Spring Boot, Java, React, Typescript, PostgreSQL, Docker, Colima, GitLab, and GPT.
Consulted Airblox to integrate Active Campaign, a Sales & CRM tool for managing deals, email notifications, and user tracking.
Launched an internship with a cohort of 5 computer science students to work on full-stack development and AI projects.
Deployed a platform for curating daily global news using News API, Gemini, Django, and a Linux based AWS-EC2 instance.

projects.title: Fine-Tuned I/O Trace Synthesis
projects.summary: Fine-tuned an SLM with LoRA to generate synthetic scientific I/O traces.
projects.body: Fine-tuned SLMs (Granite 3.3B, Gemma) using Hugging Face and LoRA to generate synthetic DLIO HPC I/O traces, enforcing POSIX grammar constraints and evaluating temporal fidelity, scalability, and failure modes for low-cost workload analysis.

projects.title: Simple-GPT
projects.summary: Reproduced GPT-2 by pre-training on FineWeb-Edu dataset using PyTorch.
projects.body: Reproduced GPT-2 using PyTorch and pre-trained on FineWeb-Edu dataset (10B tokens) to surpass Hellaswag performance.

projects.title: Distributed Key-Val File Storage System & Benchmarking
projects.summary: Architected a distributed file storage system with lxd containerized VMs
projects.body: Architected a local distributed NFS environment with Ubuntu 22.04 and LXD containerization based VMs to benchmark I/O operations performance for Cassandra and MongoDB. Utilized C, Unix Shell, C++, and Python in the span of the project.

projects.title: AWS Streaming Data Pipeline
projects.summary: Automated ML training on a streaming/batch telecom churn data using AWS components.
projects.body: Implemented an automated ML pipeline based on AWS SageMaker, Kinesis, Firehose, and S3 to collect, compile, and pre-process streaming data and train an ML model that detects potential telecom churn with 10K+ data batches.

projects.title: COVID-19 Tweets Analysis
projects.summary: End-to-end NLP pipeline categorizing Covid-19 related tweets.
projects.body: Implemented an end-to-end NLP pipeline in Python to categorize 6K+ COVID related tweets through crowdsourcing, data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model training with Cohen’s kappa, bag-of-words, and SVM.
